tools.description: Read one full frozen Pattern record by its exact ID through one GET /v1/patterns/{id}. Returns pattern_record with accepted:false after canonical revision and normalized Program validation. No files, USB, ticket preparation, compilation or execution. Legacy Effect expansion is validated by the authoritative Store, not recompiled here. To play a record, explicitly select its exact ID and revision through a supported fixed-reference execution tool.
tools.name: get_pattern

tools.description: List configured daemon devices. Optional include_capabilities returns data {devices,capabilities} with the daemon's software compiler catalog; default data remains a device array. Optional prepare_request independently returns a fresh request_ticket bound to this daemon instance, without submitting or reserving a job; save it before submission. Repeated preparation creates different tickets.
tools.name: list_devices

tools.description: Read the daemon's bounded Pattern library directory through GET /v1/patterns. Takes only an empty object; no id, path, limit, device, ticket or write. Returns pattern_list with accepted:false. Summaries describe server-validated frozen records; they do not prove device support, grant execution, compile an effect, or run a pattern. The displayed absolute library path is never opened by this adapter. Missing/unsupported/unavailable libraries remain errors; no fallback, auto-import or replacement library.
tools.name: list_patterns

path.description: Daemon-selected absolute display path; adapter never opens it

tools.description: Compile one versioned light action through one read-only daemon POST, without a Job or ticket. set/off/fade and artistic blink/breathe/pulse/alternate/rainbow share contract nb1-light-action/v1. Explicit nb1-light-action/experimental-v2 supports Orbit with 4 or 8 paired long-fade segments and returns a separate FrameProgram. Optional serial checks cached capabilities only. Colors accept the resolve_color grammar. Returns light_preview, accepted:false; no local effect compilation, retry or direct fallback. Legacy pulse and v1 actions retain their original behavior.

action.description: One action in the unified light namespace. breathe is a symmetric cosine16 envelope; new pulse is fast attack, decay, rest. All actions are finite; daemon enforces <=1024 executed steps/24h. Legacy run_program.effect.pulse is unchanged.

tools.description: Resolve one color notation through the daemon without a Job, USB access, Gamma or brightness correction. Accept a string (#RRGGBB/#RGB or fixed CSS name), closed rgb8 object, or closed hsv object. RGB8 channels are integers 0–255; HSV uses degrees 0–360 and percentages 0–100, plain decimal with at most six fractional digits, no exponent or negative zero. Returns color_resolution, accepted:false. The daemon validates numeric lexemes and owns CSS names/HSV conversion; use canonical_color in existing Program/Effect/set. Unknown route/errors never fall back or retry and do not imply an unknown Job outcome.

Never prepares/replaces tickets, retries a write or submits a low-level frame as a substitute for the high-level action. Job acceptance is not completion; use get_job. No dry_run: use preview_light.
